# Voice messaging: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Voice messages must not be stored longer than 7 days, under the Messaging Privacy Rules. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a user, I want my voice messages to disappear from the server after a week so that old ones do not pile up.
US-2 As a user, I want to play messages at double speed so that I save time.
US-3 As a user, I want to record a voice message so that I can talk without typing.
constraints: Voice messages must not be stored longer than 7 days, under the Messaging Privacy Rules.
